scope: Exact bounded Q24 shard-header observations and one minimal public GroupedNvfp4Linear proposal. No whole artifact support or native FP4 GEMM numerical equivalence.

observed.globals: Separately named F32[1] input_scale and weight_scale_2 per sampled expert/projection; no values read. Independent names do not prove different or equal values.

requests.network_scope: First3 of200 fixed-revision shard headers, not all512 expert headers.

ports: 1 U8 W[E,N,K/2], adjacent low nibble first
minimal_proposal.geometry: Positive T,S,E,N,K; K%16=0; A_slots=1 orS; dense or proven real zero-slot-stride A; checked I32 IDs including valid duplicates.
minimal_proposal.math: Exactly extend current Nvfp4Linear group16 software-reference QDQ and scale-first weight BF16 operand boundaries; F32 backend dot then BF16 output.
minimal_proposal.critical_sharing_limit: Selected IG[e] changes current activation QDQ. Sharing raw A does not justify one T*K quantized tensor across experts or gate/up projections. Minimal actual scratch is BF16[T,S,K], with no raw-A expansion or dense E*N*K decoded bank.
minimal_proposal.reuse: Current NativePlan/parallel routes, native CUDA Queue/status/capture, Apple integer Metal/checked status, and Vulkan phased shader/status paths. Add exact custom schema and SF carrier wiring; no new executor, model whitelist or producer-generalization mode.

current_gaps: No public six-port grouped ModelOpt NVFP4 reference operation or checked selected-expert IG/WG routing yet.
GroupedFloat4Linear uses a different group32-weight/group128-FP8-activation math; GroupedMatMul uses F32 activation/output and is not an equivalent numerical fallback.
Backend grouped QDQ, selected IDs validation, real activation strides, checked workspace and narrow E4M3 SF admission still require implementation.

whole_bank_limit.confirmed_current_vulkan: vulkan_program.cc plain U8 element_count>INT32_MAX is rejected; existing nvfp4 lowering also requires byte capacity<=UINT32_MAX and device maxStorageBufferRange.
whole_bank_limit.apple_boundary: Current input_spec checks per-axis int bounds; this review does not prove an Apple4GiB total-bank rejection.
whole_bank_limit.consequence: Small operator/regression coverage cannot certify the Q24 full model or bank. No new multi-buffer carrier is designed in this proposal.

source_math_pin.claim_limit: Reference for existing Hyle software contract; not the Q24 actual runtime/producer revision or hardware-native W4A4 contract.

limits: Only sampled header dtype/shape/offset metadata was read; no nibble payload, scale values, positivity, equality, quality or deployment numerics were verified.
Q24 producer/runtime pin and hardware scaled-FP4 GEMM equivalence remain unknown.
This record proposes a mathematical operation; it does not change the model table or mark the artifact supported.
